# Ayah Bookmark Checklist: Ayah Bookmark

**Purpose**: Validate the quality of the requirements for the ayah bookmark (migration and backup safety, scope rules, the fix of the feature 006 icon, the tint on the Mushaf page, the note flow, the strings awaiting the owner, and test-first coverage) before tasks are written.
**Created**: 2026-11-25
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md), [plan.md](../plan.md), [research.md](../research.md), [data-model.md](../data-model.md), [contracts/](../contracts/)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command (standard depth; audience: the author and the owner).
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Migration safety

- [x] CHK001 Is "nothing is lost" defined by fields (id, page, note, owner, time of every bookmark; every wird, portion and setting) and by a data set size (at least 50 bookmarks), not only as an intention? [Measurability, Spec §FR-013, §SC-003]
- [x] CHK002 Is the proof required to use data made by the previous layout in a real database file, made before the layout is changed? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013, Plan research D2, D11]
- [x] CHK003 Is an update that stops halfway specified (the app starts again, nothing half changed, finished next start)? [Exception Flow, Spec User Story 4 scenario 7, §SC-003]
- [x] CHK004 Is it required that a fresh install and a migrated phone end with the same layout, and is that checkable? [Consistency, Spec §FR-013, Plan research D2]
- [x] CHK005 Are the constraints that keep a row valid ("both surah and ayah or neither", ranges) stated with where each is enforced (database, repository, backup import)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008, Data Model Bookmarks rules, Plan research D1]
- [x] CHK006 Is the one thing the database cannot check (an ayah exists, the page is where it begins) given an owner in the documents? [Gap, Plan research D1, D3, Data Model Rules]
- [x] CHK007 Is going back to an older build on a migrated phone stated as unsupported, rather than left silent? [Clarity, Spec Assumptions]

## Backup safety

- [x] CHK008 Is the rule for which version number is written stated in the requirement itself (2 only when an ayah bookmark exists, otherwise exactly today's file), not only in an assumption? [Consistency, Spec §FR-014, Assumptions] (fixed: FR-014 said "new version number (2)" while the assumption said "only when needed")
- [x] CHK009 Is it stated what an older build does with a version-2 file, and is the code that does it cited? [Clarity, Spec User Story 4 scenario 4, Plan research D3]
- [x] CHK010 Are the invalid ayah bookmarks listed (no such ayah, surah alone, ayah alone, wrong page, ayah keys in a version-1 file) with the outcome "nothing changes"? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014, §SC-004, Data Model Backup file] (fixed: the version-1 case was only in the plan)
- [x] CHK011 Is the import still one transaction, and is a failure halfway still specified to change nothing? [Consistency, Spec §FR-014, User Story 4 scenario 5]
- [x] CHK012 Is it stated that the tint switch and notes travel in the file, and that a restore makes the reader follow without a restart? [Coverage, Spec §FR-014, §FR-024, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK013 Is the source of the ayah counts for validation named, including what happens when it is missing? [Dependency, Plan research D3]
- [x] CHK014 Is the existing refusal message reused word for word, with no new string for it? [Consistency, Spec Assumptions strings table]

## Scope rules

- [x] CHK015 Is "the current scope" defined once and reused by the sheet's state, the toggle, the note save, the tint and the undo? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002, §FR-021, §FR-022, Data Model Scope]
- [x] CHK016 Is the behaviour defined when the same ayah has bookmarks in several scopes (state, remove, note, tint, list)? [Coverage, Spec Edge Cases, User Story 2 scenario 3]
- [x] CHK017 Is the behaviour defined for a scope change while the reader is open (switch wird, browse mode, wird deleted), for the tint and for the sheet? [Coverage, Spec §FR-022, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK018 Is the case of duplicates in one scope (possible only from a restored file) specified for the toggle and the note? [Edge Case, Spec Edge Cases, §FR-021]
- [x] CHK019 Is the owner of a new bookmark (wird or general) the same for the bookmark action and for the note save? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003, §FR-021(a)]

## The feature 006 icon fix

- [x] CHK020 Is the icon's meaning stated as a rule about data (page bookmarks of the page and scope) that decides both its state and its tap? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK021 Is the old behaviour named as the bug, with the requirement that the regression test fails on it? [Measurability, Spec §FR-011, §SC-012, Plan research D4]
- [x] CHK022 Is undo after the icon's removal required to restore exactly the removed rows and nothing else? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011, User Story 8 scenario 3]
- [x] CHK023 Is it stated that every existing feature 006 test stays valid, and why (they use page bookmarks only)? [Consistency, Plan research D4, Spec §FR-020]
- [x] CHK024 Is the case "a page with only an ayah bookmark" specified for the icon's state and its tap? [Coverage, Spec User Story 8 scenarios 1 and 4]

## The tint

- [x] CHK025 Is "light" and "visible" turned into numbers (the tint against the bare paper at least 1.15:1 and at most 1.50:1), and is the text contrast on it a number (4.5:1)? [Measurability, Spec §FR-023, Plan research D6] (fixed: the spec said the minimum was "set in the plan" and the plan gave only the values)
- [x] CHK026 Is "distinguishable from the highlight" a measurable rule (hue distance of at least 40 degrees) plus the owner's own check, for both looks? [Measurability, Spec §FR-023, §SC-015]
- [x] CHK027 Is every colour drawn on a tinted word covered by the contrast rule (the page ink and Night Reader's end marker), not only the text? [Completeness, Plan research D6] (fixed: the end marker was missing)
- [x] CHK028 Is the layering with the temporary highlight defined (the highlight replaces the tint, looks as before, tint returns after)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-023, User Story 7 scenario 5]
- [x] CHK029 Is "changes no geometry" a number (0 px difference of every word, line and rectangle, in every frame, tint on and off), with a baseline recorded before the first edit? [Measurability, Spec §FR-016, §SC-010, Plan research D11]
- [x] CHK030 Is the ayah crossing two pages specified with a named case (2:282, pages 48 and 49), and is the stored page of the bookmark kept at the first? [Clarity, Spec §FR-025, §SC-014] (corrected during implementation: no ayah crosses a page in this edition, 2:282 fills page 48; FR-025 and SC-014 now name page 48 only, spec correction of 2026-11-26)
- [x] CHK031 Are the moments the tint appears and disappears all listed (add, remove, undo, delete from the list, restore, wird switch or deletion, the setting) and tied to "within one frame"? [Completeness, Spec §FR-026, §SC-016] (fixed: "delete from the list «علامات»" was missing)
- [x] CHK032 Is the "does not slow page turning" requirement measurable in a widget test (build counts, no database read in a turn) and on the phone (feature 010's frame numbers with 200 bookmarks)? [Measurability, Spec §FR-026, §SC-016]
- [x] CHK033 Is it stated what the tint does not do: no tint for page bookmarks, for another scope, in the shared picture or PDF, or when the setting is off? [Coverage, Spec §FR-022, §FR-024, §FR-027]
- [x] CHK034 Is the gap between two tinted words (not tinted, as with the highlight) a stated consequence of the no-new-geometry rule, rather than a surprise? [Clarity, Plan research D6]
- [x] CHK035 Is the Settings switch fully specified: label, default, storage, live effect, backup, restore reload? [Completeness, Spec §FR-024, Plan research D7, Contracts ui.md §6]

## The note flow

- [x] CHK036 Is it stated that there is no gesture other than a tap (no long press on the bookmark action), and that the note action is a visible row? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001, Clarifications]
- [x] CHK037 Are all four saves (create, replace, clear, nothing) and cancel specified with their messages and their undo? [Completeness, Spec §FR-021, User Story 6, Data Model four saves]
- [x] CHK038 Are the reader's own assumptions about the note flow marked as such, awaiting the owner, and separate from his words? [Traceability, Spec Clarifications "Author's reading"]
- [x] CHK039 Are the field's limits stated (200 characters, trimmed, spaces only = empty, prefilled with the current note)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-015, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK040 Is the failure of a note save specified (field stays open with the text, nothing shown as saved)? [Exception Flow, Spec §FR-021, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK041 Is it stated that removing the bookmark removes its note and that undo brings it back exactly? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, User Story 2 scenario 5]
- [x] CHK042 Is the line under the note field (what saving will do) specified in both states, so no hidden behaviour remains? [Completeness, Spec §FR-015, Contracts ui.md §2]
- [x] CHK043 Is "editing the note of a page bookmark" stated as out of scope, so nobody adds it silently? [Scope, Spec Clarifications, §FR-021]
- [x] CHK044 Is the note shown in the list as page-bookmark notes are today, with the same line limit? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010, Contracts ui.md §4]

## Test-first coverage

- [x] CHK049 Is every contract (repository methods, undo, controller state, pure tint function, settings notifier, sheet rows, note dialog, list row, backup, strings) mapped to a test file written before the code? [Traceability, Contracts dart-interfaces.md "Tests mapped to contracts"]
- [x] CHK050 Is the order that matters stated (real v1 file and geometry baseline before the first `lib/` edit; the 006 regression red on today's code)? [Dependency, Plan research D11]
- [x] CHK051 Are the few existing tests that must change named, with the reason, and the others declared untouched? [Completeness, Spec §FR-020, Plan research D13]
- [x] CHK052 Is the phone check specified with its steps, its stop rule (never unlock, ask before any input or install, a backup exported first) and the owner's own check as the last step? [Completeness, Plan research D15, Quickstart, Spec §SC-011]
- [x] CHK053 Are the small edits to the shared files (`reader_screen.dart`, `mushaf_page.dart`, `ayah_sheet.dart`, `bookmarks_sheet.dart`) listed one by one, with what stays untouched? [Dependency, Plan research D12]
- [x] CHK054 Is the web version stated as paused, with only the data format kept one? [Scope, Spec §FR-018, Plan research D14]

## Notes

- Evaluated by the author against spec.md, plan.md, research.md, data-model.md and contracts/ on 2026-11-25: 54 items, all
  satisfied after the fixes below; none left open.
- **Fixed** (real gaps found while evaluating; each edited in the documents, not weakened):
  1. FR-014 now says the version rule itself (2 only when an ayah bookmark exists; version-1 file with surah/ayah is invalid)
     instead of leaving it to an assumption (CHK008, CHK010).
  2. Research D6 now gives the numbers behind "light" and "visible" (tint against paper 1.15 to 1.50:1) and the contrast of
     Night Reader's end marker on the tint (7.0:1) (CHK025, CHK027).
  3. FR-026 and SC-016 now list a delete from the «علامات» list among the moments the tint must follow within one frame
     (CHK031).
  4. The spec's strings table now holds the note save failure line, so spec, contracts and UI contract agree (CHK046).
- **Accepted as they are** (not gaps): the line under the note field is chosen when the field opens, while the case itself is
  decided from the database at save time (a bookmark deleted in between only changes which of the four results happens, never
  loses data); the tint is not continuous across the gap between two words (Principle I and II forbid new geometry).
- **Waiting for the owner** (not requirement-quality gaps): the confirmation of the strings, of the note flow's details in
  "Author's reading", and the eye check of the tint against the highlight on the phone.
- **Convergence (T049, 2026-11-25)**: re-read against the code that was built.
  1. CHK030: the crossing case was a wrong fact (see the item); the documents were corrected on 2026-11-25 (commit d706cbf).
  2. CHK031: as built, a delete in «علامات» takes the tint away in the first frame after the sheet closes, not while it is
     open (FR-026, research D5 now say so).
  3. CHK046: the three strings of FR-028 («عرض الملاحظة», «تعديل», «إغلاق») are now in the spec's table and the contracts.
  4. CHK047 and "Waiting for the owner": the strings were confirmed on 2026-11-25 (T048, «كلها تمام»). Still waiting: the eye
     check of the tint against the highlight on the phone (SC-015) and the rest of the phone walk (T045); the note flow's
     details of "Author's reading" were used by the owner on the phone but not answered point by point.
  5. CHK051: two existing tests changed, one number each (`backup_service_test.dart`, `backup_ui_test.dart`), as D13 says.
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist state but does not modify markers.
